requirement.statement: The system SHALL define a serializable renderer-neutral RichDocument model and pure lower/parse logic over neutral Projection/Authoring data for supported blocks, marks, tables, code, Mermaid and Halfcode embeds; only support SHALL adapt concrete xnl-core XnlNode to or from neutral data and materialize final candidates, and normal authoring SHALL transform Domain XNL to RichDocument to Tiptap JSON without HTML or DOM as an intermediate fact.

case.given: A valid RichDocument XNL source with stable block #id values.
case.when: The pure dialect lowers and parses it.
case.then: Supported semantic structure, order, marks and block identity SHALL be preserved under canonical normalization.

case.given: The source contains an unsupported or lossy construct.
case.when: The dialect lowers or parses it.
case.then: The result SHALL contain actionable diagnostics and SHALL NOT silently fall back to HTML, raw JSON or plain text.

case.given: A stable block moves while retaining #id.
case.when: The accepted candidate is diffed.
case.then: #id SHALL align the tree and identify the move and SHALL NOT be emitted as an ordinary field update.

case.given: Concrete xnl-core XnlNode input is lowered or a final candidate is materialized.
case.when: The package boundary is inspected.
case.then: Only support SHALL import xnl-core or xnl-vfs and SHALL reuse the existing parser and mutation engine; contract and logic SHALL operate on neutral data and SHALL introduce no parallel AST, parser or mutation engine.

requirement.statement: The dedicated dg-cell-mvi-halfcode-tiptap-vue capsule SHALL project RichDocument to Tiptap/ProseMirror and normalize editor transactions into revision-free serializable XnlProjectionPresenterEditIntent data; a trusted host SHALL translate the Interaction and construct XnlAuthoringProposal with the current live revision, while ProseMirror state, selection, composition and history SHALL remain local projection state and SHALL NOT write Domain XNL or persistence directly.

case.given: A Tiptap transaction changes supported document content.
case.when: The adapter normalizes the transaction.
case.then: It SHALL emit only the revision-free kind=&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;interaction&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; variant of XnlProjectionPresenterEditIntent with affected stable identities and SHALL contain no AST, ValueHost, VFS or mutation writer authority; a command variant from the Tiptap normalizer SHALL fail closed.

case.given: A trusted host receives a valid Interaction edit intent.
case.when: It translates the Interaction for the current projection and prepares authoring.
case.then: The host SHALL call translateXnlProjectionInteraction exactly once, then read the submission-time live revision and construct XnlAuthoringProposal; the adapter and NodeView SHALL neither receive nor call authoring submit.

case.given: Composition, selection and undo/redo transactions occur.
case.when: The adapter groups and publishes edits.
case.then: IME SHALL publish only after the configured semantic boundary and undo/redo SHALL create proposals rather than mutate accepted XNL directly.

case.given: A transaction changes only selection or metadata, or is an intermediate composition transaction without a document change.
case.when: The adapter observes it.
case.then: It SHALL emit no edit intent and SHALL NOT invoke the trusted bridge; selection or history metadata MAY accompany a genuine document-changing Interaction only as serializable provenance.

case.given: The Halfcode Document Presenter dependency slice is inspected.
case.when: Contract, logic, support, the existing Halfcode Vue renderer and the new adapter are scanned.
case.then: Within that slice, Tiptap, ProseMirror and NodeView dependencies SHALL exist only in the dedicated adapter; Vue MAY exist in the existing Vue renderer and new adapter, while contract, logic and support SHALL remain free of Vue, Tiptap, ProseMirror and DOM. The existing admin-element-plus HTML-first editor is a legacy baseline outside this slice, and this track SHALL add no Tiptap dependency to any other package.

requirement.statement: A Halfcode Component or Capsule NodeView SHALL receive only the exact readonly view proven by XnlProjectionPresenterRuntimeFacet, immutable occurrence snapshot, DocumentInstanceRef and an emitEditIntent grant restricted to XnlProjectionPresenterEditIntent; the host adapter SHALL retain registry owner tokens and cleanup authority, and embedded code SHALL NOT possess raw Scope runtime, Domain AST, ValueHost, translator, authoring session, VFS/VCS or mutation writer authority.

case.given: An embedded Halfcode occurrence has a stable namespaced x-id.
case.when: The NodeView host mounts, updates and unmounts it.
case.then: The runtime registry SHALL use a host-private owner-token lifecycle, preserve occurrence address and prevent stale cleanup from removing a replacement mount; embedded code SHALL never receive the token or unregister capability.

case.given: A NodeView adapter is constructed from a Scope containing extra capabilities.
case.when: The embedded component renders or requests an edit.
case.then: Only explicitly granted facade data/functions SHALL be visible and every edit SHALL leave as serializable proposal data.

case.given: Two active embedded occurrences claim the same x-id in one Document occurrence.
case.when: They register.
case.then: The second registration SHALL fail with a structured diagnostic and SHALL NOT use last-wins or DOM lookup.

requirement.statement: Persistent Domain #id allocation for new or copied RichDocument nodes SHALL be owned by a host/authoring identity allocator during candidate construction; move SHALL preserve #id, replacement SHALL be delete-and-add, and occurrence x-id SHALL be derived only after persistent identity exists.

case.given: A Tiptap transaction inserts a new persistent document node.
case.when: The trusted host materializes the authoring candidate.
case.then: The host-owned allocator SHALL assign a fresh #id before occurrence x-id is derived.

case.given: An existing subtree is copied or moved across parents.
case.when: The candidate is materialized and diffed.
case.then: Every copied persistent node SHALL receive a fresh #id, while every moved node SHALL retain its original #id and be recognized as a move.

case.given: A node identity is replaced or one persistent node is projected in multiple roles.
case.when: The accepted candidate is projected.
case.then: Identity replacement SHALL be delete-and-add, and each role SHALL derive a distinct namespaced x-id from the same persistent #id.

requirement.statement: Supported RichDocument fixtures SHALL satisfy canonical GetPut, and an accepted Tiptap Interaction SHALL satisfy PutGet through the existing accepted-first authoring session; stale, rejected or lossy pre-acceptance edits SHALL advance neither truth, while post-acceptance persistence failure SHALL retain advanced live truth, leave persisted truth unchanged and enter dirty-failed.

case.given: A supported canonical Domain XNL document.
case.when: It is lowered, projected, parsed and normalized without an edit.
case.then: The result SHALL equal the normalized input and SHALL preserve stable block identity.

case.given: A supported Tiptap edit proposal is accepted by the authoring owner.
case.when: The persisted XNL is reloaded and reprojected.
case.then: The visible semantic edit SHALL match the proposal and the adapter local draft SHALL not become a second truth.

case.given: An edit is stale, invalid or lossy before acceptance, or persistence fails after acceptance.
case.when: The pipeline evaluates it.
case.then: Pre-acceptance failure SHALL advance neither live nor persisted revision; post-acceptance persistence failure SHALL keep the advanced accepted live revision and reproject it, keep persisted revision unchanged, enter dirty-failed, and reject further edits until retry or explicit reload.

requirement.statement: The dedicated Tiptap adapter SHALL expose composable table authoring commands and a Mermaid NodeView through its package root; every document change SHALL remain a Tiptap transaction normalized into a revision-free Interaction, while Domain XNL, authoring revision, mutation acceptance and persistence remain owned by the trusted host.

case.given: A real Tiptap Editor is created only from the package public extensions.
case.when: A consumer inserts or structurally edits a table.
case.then: Official Tiptap table commands SHALL be callable for table, row, column, merge, split and header operations, and the adapter SHALL preserve supported RichDocument identity and span attributes.

case.given: A table command changes document structure or cell content.
case.when: The adapter observes the transaction.
case.then: The change SHALL leave the adapter only as a revision-free Interaction and SHALL NOT directly write Domain XNL, authoring state or persistence.

case.given: A supported RichDocument table is projected, edited and parsed.
case.when: Canonical normalization is applied.
case.then: Table semantics, ordering, stable moved identities and supported cell spans SHALL be preserved without HTML or DOM reverse authoring.

case.given: A product binds a safe Mermaid render Effect at its composition root.
case.when: The Mermaid NodeView mounts or its source changes.
case.then: The composition root SHALL provide one exact runtime whose effects contain render and diagnostic contracts; the NodeView SHALL invoke each as output = fn(runtime, input, config), while its private DOM commit remains host-owned, and SHALL NOT accept loose callbacks or construct a concrete renderer implementation.

case.given: Mermaid rendering is asynchronous, rejects, throws or completes after a newer source or destroy.
case.when: A render result attempts to commit.
case.then: Only the latest live request SHALL reach the host-owned private DOM commit with structured safe output; stale or destroyed results SHALL be discarded and failures SHALL reach the separate diagnostic Effect without changing Domain truth.

case.given: A user edits Mermaid source through the NodeView.
case.when: The source is updated.
case.then: The NodeView SHALL update its node through a Tiptap transaction normalized as an explicit Mermaid source Interaction and SHALL NOT directly mutate RichDocument, XNL, VFS or the authoring session.

case.given: A product consumes only the package root.
case.when: It assembles table, Mermaid and Halfcode embed browser capabilities.
case.then: One public browser host SHALL own one canonical extension registry and compose table, Mermaid, Component and Capsule NodeViews without duplicate extensions, deep imports, raw NodeViewRenderer exposure or product-specific deduplication; existing Component/Capsule authority containment SHALL remain intact.

requirement.statement: The foundation SHALL define renderer-neutral, serializable canonical RichDocument semantic edit and Domain Command contracts and SHALL expose a public canonical translator or dialect for xnl.rich-document.edit; the Tiptap normalizer SHALL emit that canonical vocabulary without Tiptap JSON, HTML, DOM, revision or writer authority, and consumers SHALL NOT need to reimplement the translator.

case.given: A supported Tiptap transaction normalizes insert, delete, move, text, mark, table, code or Mermaid source changes.
case.when: The public canonical translator validates and translates the revision-free Interaction.
case.then: It SHALL return one canonical RichDocument edit command with an exact Domain target and lossless serializable semantic data for every emitted edit kind.

case.given: A transaction changes text and marks together or copies a persistent subtree.
case.when: The normalizer creates canonical semantic edit data.
case.then: Text and mark edits SHALL carry exact final inline runs, and each copied persistent node SHALL carry source provenance only when it uniquely aligns to an accepted stable #id; arbitrary inserted nodeId claims SHALL NOT become copy provenance.

case.given: An Interaction has an unknown kind, unresolved plan target, extra or accessor-backed fields, conflicting identities, lossy payload or malformed before and after facts.
case.when: The canonical translator evaluates it.
case.then: It SHALL return structured rejected or unsupported diagnostics and SHALL NOT emit a partial command or consult authoring, VFS, session, writer or persistence authority.

case.given: A non-Tiptap consumer imports the canonical semantic contract and translator from package roots.
case.when: The dependency slice is inspected.
case.then: Contract, logic and support SHALL remain free of Tiptap, ProseMirror, Vue, DOM and HTML dependencies, while the adapter public semantic types SHALL be aliases or strict specializations of the canonical contract rather than a second vocabulary.

requirement.statement: The foundation owner SHALL expose a package-root runtime-first semantic candidate materializer that applies an accepted XnlRichDocument and canonical translated RichDocument edit command atomically to XnlRichDocumentCandidateMaterializationResult, preserving stable #id structure and copy-origin handoff while owning no writer, VFS, session, revision, submit, persistence, Tiptap JSON or HTML authority.

case.given: A canonical command contains any valid combination of insert, delete, move, text, mark, table, code and mermaid-source edits emitted by the public normalizer.
case.when: The public semantic candidate materializer applies the command to the accepted RichDocument.
case.then: It SHALL return a normalized deeply immutable candidate whose semantic structure equals the requested final document, including exact inline marks, table topology and spans, code language/text and Mermaid source.

case.given: A first canonical semantic edit is accepted and a second valid edit is projected and normalized from that latest accepted RichDocument.
case.when: The same package-root translator, materializer, identity allocator and trusted host process the second Interaction.
case.then: The second edit SHALL be evaluated only against the latest accepted baseline, SHALL be accepted without stale hidden materializer or identity facts, and SHALL preserve exact-once translation, materialization, allocation and submission.

case.given: A command contains stale before facts, invalid parent/index, unknown references, duplicate or overlapping operations, a cyclic move, conflicting text and mark results, or an unsupported semantic node.
case.when: The materializer validates and plans the command.
case.then: It SHALL reject the whole command against one accepted baseline with actionable diagnostics, SHALL NOT partially apply edits, and SHALL leave accepted input and all external authority unchanged.

case.given: A command moves an accepted subtree, inserts a new subtree, copies an accepted subtree or replaces identity.
case.when: The candidate and copy origins are classified before trusted-host allocation.
case.then: Moved nodes SHALL retain every stable #id, new and replacement nodes SHALL have collision-safe temporary candidate ids, every copied persistent node SHALL produce an exact copyOrigin, and replacement SHALL remain delete-and-add rather than an ordinary id update.

case.given: A trusted authoring host composes the public canonical translator, materializer and an existing host-owned identity allocator.
case.when: A revision-free Interaction is submitted while accepted revision is stable or changes during materialization.
case.then: The host SHALL translate and materialize exactly once, allocate fresh ids only for new/copy/replacement identities, use the submission-time live revision when stable, and reject concurrent change without submitting when the revision changed.

case.given: A supported canonical Interaction is accepted or a stale, malformed, lossy or persistence-failing proposal is evaluated.
case.when: The existing accepted-first authoring pipeline completes and reprojects the result.
case.then: Accepted edits SHALL satisfy PutGet, pre-acceptance failures SHALL advance neither live nor persisted truth, existing post-acceptance dirty-failed semantics SHALL remain intact, and no adapter or materializer surface SHALL expose writer, VFS, VCS, session, revision, submit or persistence authority.

requirement.statement: The dedicated Tiptap adapter SHALL provide a canonical browser DOM serializer for listItem while preserving the RichDocument block+ content contract, stable node identity and revision-free transaction authoring; this view serializer SHALL NOT become HTML or DOM reverse-authoring authority.

case.given: A package-root real Tiptap Editor receives canonical bullet and ordered lists.
case.when: The browser view mounts their listItem nodes.
case.then: The adapter SHALL render ul, ol and li elements without a missing toDOM failure and SHALL preserve list order and stable nodeId attributes.

case.given: A canonical listItem begins with a supported block such as blockquote rather than paragraph.
case.when: The schema validates and the real browser Editor renders it.
case.then: The listItem SHALL remain valid under content block+ and SHALL render through the same canonical serializer.

case.given: The adapter source and boundary tests are inspected.
case.when: The list serializer is distinguished from authoring inputs.
case.then: The serializer SHALL only lower a ProseMirror node to a browser output spec and SHALL NOT parse HTML or DOM, inspect page state, write Domain XNL or acquire mutation, VFS, session or persistence authority.

requirement.statement: The dedicated Tiptap adapter SHALL allow its local-draft lifecycle to bind to a real canonical EditorState so that the Editor, draft document and transactions share one ProseMirror schema lineage; the binding SHALL remain adapter-local projection state and SHALL expose no Domain writer or authoring authority.

case.given: A real package-root Editor is initialized with canonical extensions and its initial EditorState is bound as a local draft.
case.when: A supported document-changing transaction is applied.
case.then: The existing draft lifecycle SHALL apply it without schema-identity rejection and SHALL publish exactly one revision-free Interaction through the injected Effect.

case.given: The bound Editor emits selection-only, composition, undo or redo transactions.
case.when: The existing local lifecycle processes them.
case.then: Selection-only changes SHALL remain silent, composition SHALL buffer and settle once, and history SHALL remain local proposal-producing state rather than direct Domain mutation.

case.given: A bound local draft receives matching or replacing accepted projection feedback.
case.when: The adapter reprojects it.
case.then: Matching acceptance SHALL preserve current state, selection and plugin lineage while clearing pending; replacement SHALL reuse the bound schema and plugin configuration, reset stale history and apply the existing stale-draft policy.

case.given: The binding receives malformed, accessor-backed or noncanonical EditorState data.
case.when: It validates the boundary.
case.then: It SHALL reject before invoking emitInteraction and SHALL NOT accept Editor, DOM, raw NodeView, authoring session, revision, VFS/VCS, mutation writer or persistence authority.

requirement.statement: The renderer-neutral RichDocument foundation SHALL represent underline, text alignment, text color, highlight, task list, horizontal rule and hard break as canonical serializable Domain XNL semantics; enhanced code block durability SHALL remain language plus text while syntax highlighting, folding and copying remain Presenter capabilities.

case.given: A document contains underlined, colored or highlighted text and aligned paragraphs or headings.
case.when: The foundation validates, lowers, parses and normalizes it.
case.then: Every supported mark and alignment SHALL round-trip exactly with stable node identity and without HTML or style-declaration fallback.

case.given: A document contains checked and unchecked task items, horizontal rules and inline hard breaks.
case.when: The foundation processes and rematerializes the document.
case.then: Task structure, checked state, ordering, inline break position and persistent identities SHALL be preserved.

case.given: A hard break is inserted or copied through an inline replacement or a copied semantic subtree.
case.when: The candidate materializer assigns temporary identities and classifies identity changes.
case.then: Every new hard break identity SHALL avoid all accepted and same-command identities, every copied hard break SHALL retain exact copy provenance, and inserted subtrees SHALL reject forged stable hard-break identities.

case.given: A code block is syntax highlighted, copied or folded by a Presenter.
case.when: The Domain document is persisted.
case.then: Only code language, text and explicitly canonical document attributes SHALL be durable; local highlight, copy and fold state SHALL NOT enter Domain XNL.

case.given: A canonical semantic command inserts, deletes, moves or edits any newly supported node, mark or attribute.
case.when: The candidate materializer evaluates it against one accepted baseline.
case.then: The whole command SHALL apply atomically with exact before/after validation, or reject without partial mutation or external authority change.

case.given: A supported traditional document is represented as concrete XNL.
case.when: The support-owned adapter parses, materializes and serializes it.
case.then: The canonical result SHALL satisfy GetPut, preserve #id-based structure and produce readable mutations for accepted edits.

case.given: A mark, alignment, color, checked state or node shape is malformed, accessor-backed, unsafe or unknown.
case.when: Any public boundary validates it.
case.then: The foundation SHALL return structured diagnostics and SHALL NOT silently drop, coerce through HTML or emit a partial command.

case.given: The contract, logic and support packages are inspected.
case.when: The traditional semantics are implemented.
case.then: Contract and logic SHALL remain free of xnl-core, Tiptap, Vue, DOM and HTML; support MAY own concrete xnl-core adaptation but SHALL remain renderer-neutral.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL 提供由 canonical XNL RichDocument 驱动、Presentation 可配置且不拥有领域事实的可复用文档编辑器。

case.given: accepted RichDocument 包含 alignment、underline、color/highlight、task list、horizontal rule 或 hard break
case.when: 系统投影到 Tiptap 并把真实 transaction 归一化为 semantic interaction
case.then: 系统 MUST 无损保留语义、identity 与 absent/explicit 差异，并拒绝 lossy 或 unsafe 值

case.given: 业务提供只含 stable id 与 serializable options 的 DocumentEditorPresentation
case.when: 系统编译 ToolbarPlan
case.then: 结果 MUST deep frozen 且不包含 Vue、Tiptap、DOM、effect 或 closure；未知和重复配置产生确定性 diagnostics

case.given: Scope 在同 presenter id 下提供覆盖
case.when: 工具被渲染和调用
case.then: 覆盖 MUST 只改变呈现，不得替换 canonical command 语义或取得 host authority

case.given: 编辑器接收新的 accepted observation 或本地 transaction
case.when: 执行 edit、composition、undo、redo、accept、replace 或 conflict
case.then: 系统 MUST 复用同一 EditorState lineage 和既有 draft lifecycle，并只经 runtime authoring effect 发出 revision-free interaction

case.given: 容器处于宽或窄视口且存在 contextual tools
case.when: 工具栏布局和键盘导航
case.then: 全部工具 SHALL 可达，低优先级组进入 overflow，且不得以横向滚动隐藏能力

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL 以 renderer-neutral session facts 和 runtime policy 派生文档 base mode 与 occurrence overlay 的有效显示模式。

case.given: 一个由 compiled Document mode 初始化且含完整 occurrence identity 的文档会话
case.when: 调用方请求切换 base mode 或 occurrence overlay
case.then: effective mode 由 canonical base/overlay 与 runtime policy 纯派生，inherit 删除 overlay，拒绝操作不改变既有事实

case.given: 一个 policy 允许 edit 显示投影的 occurrence
case.when: Presenter 获得 mode projection
case.then: 投影不包含 authoring capability、policy implementation、ACL、DOM 或持久化 authority

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL 以单 owner session 串行管理动态显示模式，并让文档编辑器只消费受限投影。

case.given: policy 为异步且 occurrence 具有独立 lease
case.when: 宿主切换模式或权限事实失效
case.then: session MUST 原子发布 state/projection，隔离陈旧 lease、陈旧 policy response 和 subscriber 异常

case.given: 同一 accepted document 和 EditorState lineage
case.when: 只读 mode projection 在 view/edit 间变化
case.then: Editor MUST 原位 setEditable 并重编译 toolbar，且不得发出 authoring interaction 或持久化写入

case.given: effective mode 为 view
case.when: 调用方绕过可见 UI 直接执行 authoring command
case.then: 命令入口 MUST 根据最终 guard 拒绝执行

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL 为文档内嵌 Component/Capsule 提供统一 mode shell、受限模式能力与双 registry lifecycle。

case.given: occurrence effective mode 为 view
case.when: 组件直接调用 edit intent 或 shell authoring control
case.then: host MUST 拒绝 authoring 且继续允许独立授权的业务 interaction

case.given: NodeView 同步创建且 mode registration 异步完成
case.when: mount 更新销毁或 host dispose
case.then: document owner token 与 mode lease MUST 各自精确释放，迟到结果不得复活 mount

case.given: Tiptap remounts a NodeView for the same stable occurrence within one browser host.
case.when: The old and replacement NodeView lifecycles overlap or registration is still pending.
case.then: The host SHALL share one mode registration lease, preserve the occurrence projection, and unregister exactly once after the final consumer or host is disposed.

case.given: A product presentation replaces its Tiptap browser host while retaining a stable occurrence identity.
case.when: Both host generations use the presentation-owned mode registration coordinator.
case.then: The occurrence SHALL retain one lease and overlay across replacement, then unregister after the final presentation consumer is disposed.

case.given: target 声明 stable shell presenter id
case.when: runtime registry 解析 override
case.then: 仅 shell 视觉可替换，transition guard lifecycle authority MUST 保持 host-owned

case.given: An occurrence has an explicit overlay and policy restricts its inherited document mode.
case.when: The mode-aware shell projects available transitions.
case.then: Inherit SHALL be disabled when the inherited mode is not allowed and the final session transition SHALL remain authoritative.
